text:
olivia: Heads up — saw a customer provisional billing spike ~10:12 UTC. DUG into traces: mid-request model swap + reconnect produced duplicated toolcall credits when stream trimmed and retried.

sam: Ugh. Which route? Any trace ids?

olivia: Route: eu-west-1 / model-redwood-small -> fallback to quantized-v2. Trace snippet below (sanitized):

```
{"session_id":"s_9f2b","request_id":"r_20260323_1012","events":[
  {"evt":"stream_start","seq":1},
  {"evt":"toolcall","toolcall_id":"tc_100","tokens":24},
  {"evt":"model_swap","from":"redwood-small","to":"quantized-v2"},
  {"evt":"stream_truncate","reason":"handoff"},
  {"evt":"reconnect","new_request_id":"r_20260323_1012_1"},
  {"evt":"toolcall","toolcall_id":"tc_100","tokens":24, "note":"replayed"}
]}
```

olivia: Metering pipeline saw two `toolcall` events with same `toolcall_id` in different requests and credited both as confirmed.

kai: Are we de-duping by `(customer_id, toolcall_id)` or by `(session_id, toolcall_id)`? If model swap created a new request_id we might lose the original correlation.

sam: Current ledger dedupe key is `(customer_id, request_id, toolcall_id)` — so a reconnect with new request_id will double-credit.

zheng: From an API/routing perspective, reconnect + swap is intentionally a new request to avoid cross-model KVC corruption. But we should preserve an idempotency handle for toolcalls.

olivia: Agreed. Short-term ops ask: can we mark provisional credits in the console so CS doesn't alarm users? Long-term: avoid double-credit.

sam: Proposal: router should attach `toolcall_origin` header to every toolcall credit: `initial|retry|handoff`. Ledger will treat `retry`/`handoff` as provisional unless there's confirmation from final ACK. That would require a small schema change.

kai: I like `toolcall_origin`, but we also need a stable `toolcall_global_id` that survives reconnects (server generates and injects into both initial and retry frames). The client already sends `client_tool_id` sometimes. We can fallback to that.

olivia: Ops impact: need to surface provisional vs confirmed token counts in dashboard. Right now console only shows `tokens_charged` as a single number. CS asked for provisional breakdown in the billing UI yesterday.

zheng: UX questions: how do we expose provisional credits without confusing customers? Suggested approach: show `Pending (provisional)` with hover text "charges that may be reconciled within 24h" and keep `Confirmed` separate.

sam: Telemetry plan: add a counter `token.charges{status="provisional|confirmed", origin="initial|retry|handoff", model_variant=...}`. Also emit a `toolcall_global_id` label. That lets us graph provisional spikes per origin.

kai: Implementation notes: router changes + ledger acceptance. Router to set `x-toolcall-global-id` and `x-toolcall-origin`. Ledger to accept both headers and use `(customer, toolcall_global_id)` as dedupe key when present, otherwise fallback to current.

olivia: Quick visibility step: can we add a temporary console overlay that filters recent provisional charges? If we add `provisional` flag in billing events, the backend can sum it.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New alert triggered: billing.provisional_spike > 1000 tokens/min for customer_id:cust_42 at 2026-03-23T10:12:45Z :warning:

zheng: Also need a migration plan. Some older events won't have global ids. We should run a reconciliation job to collapse duplicates in past 7 days using heuristics (session_id + timewindow + toolcall_signature).

sam: Query example for grafana (LogsQL-like):
```
{job="metering"} | json | toolcall_global_id != "" | sum by (toolcall_origin, status) (tokens)
```

kai: Edgecases: What if initial toolcall legitimately ran twice (client retried on timeout)? Our schema must allow confirmed duplicates (i.e., different content). So dedupe by global id only when present and same `tool_name` + `payload_hash` to be safe.

olivia: Ok action items:
- sam: draft schema change for `toolcall_global_id` + `toolcall_origin` (PR by EOD Thu).
- kai: router patch to inject global id on reconnects + preserve client_tool_id mapping (canary to 10% traffic)
- zheng: console mockups for provisional/confirmed toggle and help text (share by Fri)
- ops: run one-off dedupe/reconcile job for cust_42 window (help debug billing ticket)

zheng: Also adding UX/CS note explaining why provisional shows up and typical reconciliation window (24–48h). Keep language non-technical.

sam: Quick workaround for CS: mark affected provisional charges as "under review" in the internal billing UI so invoices aren't auto-sent.

olivia: Thanks. Can we also add a small telemetry delta on-canary so we can measure the rate of missing global ids before fully enforcing?

kai: Yep. Router will emit `router.telemetry.toolcall_missing_global_id{count}`. I'll wire in a graph.

ops-bot: triage-bot: Ticket created: #INC-2026-billing-provisional-spike (assigned to sam, kai, zheng).

olivia: I'll add logs for cust_42 and ping the CS rep. If everyone ok let's move to implementation tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
